privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Symma is a facial paralysis rehabilitation platform. This notice describes how the personal data of the patients and therapists who use it is processed, in accordance with the Mexican Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP).
privacy.controller: The therapist or clinic that registers the patient in Symma is the controller of their personal data.
privacy.data: Identification and contact data (name, email, phone, date of birth, gender and emergency contact) and sensitive health data (diagnosis, paralysis grade, clinical notes and exercise session results).
privacy.purpose: The data is used exclusively to plan, monitor and assess the patient's rehabilitation.
privacy.transfers: The data is not transferred to third parties without the data subject's consent, except in the cases provided for by the LFPDPPP.
privacy.rights: The data subject may request access, rectification, cancellation or opposition to the processing of their data, and may revoke their consent, by contacting the responsible therapist or clinic.
privacy.changes: Any change to this notice will be published on this page.
